note: Untested in a full run: a recipe meant for one 16 GB GPU (RTX 5080 Laptop), 132M parameters with 32K-token windows, trained with --recompute --micro-batch 1. Its 11 layers are two window layers on each side of an exact layer, then one exact layer and five sparse layers, and the MTP block's attention is a 128-token window. Its memory is not measured. Its data is the classics for now (about 4.3M tokens, so the model mostly memorizes); it changes once a larger mixture exists. Its training is one stage: 300 steps of 8 windows of 32K tokens; the stages to 1M tokens are not set yet, since their steps and batches are the recipe's to choose. A GPU where 32K tokens do not fit trains it the same with --segment 8192 or --strategy split (docs/training.md, "Long windows").
